Studio Note · Why batches take a little while

A quick note on timing — and what's coming

Right now your designs are generated on Pollinations' free tier — about 1 image every 40 seconds — so a full batch of 7 takes about ten minutes, appearing one by one as each design renders, and may carry a small Pollinations logo. We're setting up the studio's own account to speed that up: once it's in place, batches should come back to roughly 1–2 minutes and the logo will come off. Nothing you need to do — just start your batch and watch your designs land.

HOW MATCHING WORKS

Artists are scored on: delivers to your country → based in your country → style fit for your design → rating & speed. The top score is who paints your pair.

Showing the full network — pick a delivery country to see only the artists who can reach you, best match first.

Artists who join the network hand-paint with leather paints, seal with a weatherproof finisher, and ship with tracking. Once founding artists are onboarded and matching goes live, locking your final design will send it to the winning artist — your design file, your size and your address — and your pair will go straight from their bench to your door.

🎨 Your Live Design Studio

Real designs, generated on demand from your answers — your pillars, hero, colour vibe and notes become the prompt, with a different art direction and seed for each of the 7. Designs render one by one: the free generator takes about one request every 45 seconds, so a full batch lands in about ten minutes. Every render is checked before it counts — if the generator answers with a rate-limit notice instead of a design, that's caught and retried (up to 3 tries per design, each with a fresh seed), never passed off as a finished design. Yours are shown only through your private review link.
